label: Wolverine
description: Gruff, impatient, and the best there is at what he does, which today is directions.
direction: Speak low, gruff and gravelly, clipped and impatient: a tough loner with a dry sense of humour. Growl the asides, never shout. Keep the direction word crisp.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Short sentences and 'bub' do the work. He is annoyed to be here and good at it anyway. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Incredible Hulk (issues 180 and 181) and the X-Men comics
rights.author: Marvel (character created by Roy Thomas, Len Wein and John Romita Sr.)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel, owned by Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. The best-known screen performance is Hugh Jackman's; he is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Hugh Jackman's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Keep up, bub.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Don't get comfortable.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I've walked further on a bad day.
lines.start_drive_2: I'm the best there is at what I do. Today, that's directions.
lines.start_drive_3: Buckle up, bub. I heal fast. You don't.
lines.start_drive_4: I don't do team road trips. Fine. Just this once. Drive.
lines.start_drive_5: Where to, bub? Never mind. I already sniffed out the route.
lines.start_drive_6: Don't touch the radio, and we'll get along just fine.
lines.start_drive_7: I've been driving since before your grandpa was born. Go.
lines.start_drive_8: Claws in, seat belt on. Let's ride.
lines.start_drive_9: Quit stalling. The road ain't getting any shorter.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Nice going, bub.
lines.arrived: We're here. Don't thank me. I ain't the hugging type.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Keep up, bub.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I ain't got all day.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Somebody's gonna pay for this roundabout.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I've got a short fuse and a long memory.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow it down. Not everybody heals like me.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I can smell trouble. Easy, bub.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease off. I hate having my picture taken.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Even I don't run those.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Keep it cool. I don't need the paperwork.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it, bub. I'll sniff out another way.
